dimensions.assessment: Affects non-federal entities, developers, and local stakeholders involved in hydropower operations and maintenance on Bureau of Reclamation projects.
dimensions.evidence: carried out by a non-Federal entity under the provisions of a formal operations and maintenance transfer contract

dimensions.assessment: Expands non-federal hydropower eligibility from small conduits and pumped storage to all Bureau facilities, and redefines hydropower generation status from incidental to secondary.
dimensions.evidence: and inserting 'hydropower using all Bureau of Reclamation facilities'

dimensions.assessment: No federal spending appropriations or specific revenue figures are stated in the source text.
Amends section 9(c) of the Reclamation Project Act of 1939 regarding definitions, facility classifications, and FERC authorization lifetimes.
dimensions.evidence: Section 9(c) of the Reclamation Project Act of 1939 (43 U.S.C. 485h(c); 53 Stat. 1194) is amended

dimensions.assessment: Permanent statutory change governing non-federal hydropower development and site jurisdiction.

missing_information: The number of Bureau of Reclamation facilities or projects that will be developed for non-federal hydropower is not specified.
importance_detail.rationale: The bill amends the Reclamation Project Act of 1939 to broaden non-Federal hydropower development across all Bureau of Reclamation facilities and clarifies FERC and Bureau jurisdictional boundaries regarding authorizations.
